{{Quote|The Republic fleet suddenly found itself in enemy territory, fighting desperately on all sides.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
In the [[3681 BBY|first year]] of the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] went on the offensive against the revitalized [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in a '''military campaign''' for the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]. The campaign was the result of the Empire's initial foray back into the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]] after [[Time/Legends|centuries]] of [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Following its [[Assault on the Aparo sector|invasion and capture]] of the Republic's [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]], the Empire settled into the Tingel Arm, much of which had already defected to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cause. Without knowledge of the defection, the Republic called upon its [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] to retake the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Although they had hoped to capitalize on their alliances with the peoples of [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]], [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], and [[Ruuria/Legends|Ruuria]] in the Tingel Arm, the Republic forces instead found themselves in a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] for survival, as those [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] had already been overtaken by the Empire. Despite being reinforced with [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from the rest of the [[Navy/Legends|Navy]], the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was overwhelmed when the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] arrived to aid the Empire's puppet governments on the Tingel Arm worlds. With Belkadan, Sernpidal, and Ruuria secure, the Sith were able to move their naval fleets to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]&mdash;their ancestral [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and the true target of their early campaigns. The Republic withdrew from the Tingel Arm shortly thereafter, defeated once again by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military's]] blitz.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Sith had secretly established puppet governments on Belkadan, Sernpidal, and Ruuria.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
After the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] fled the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]] and worked to reconstruct itself into a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new empire]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Empire">{{Holonet|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}</ref> During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] meticulously planned and prepared his invasion of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The Empire made secret alliances with Republic-aligned [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] and installed its own puppet governments on the planets to ensure their subservience.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] made its presence known on the fringes of the Tingel Arm, luring in Republic observers before [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|destroying]] them in the first conflict of what would become known as the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Timeline 6" />

In the immediate wake of the opening shots of the war, the Republic was slow to organize its [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] to defend the worlds of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. As a result, the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] [[Assault on the Aparo sector|fell]] to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] before the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] even reached the region. Finally, in response to the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military's]] sudden and swift attacks, the Republic rallied its [[Navy/Legends|naval]] forces and charged headlong into the Tingel Arm, but were unaware that many worlds in the region had already surrendered to the Empire and allied with the Sith.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==The campaign==
[[File:Tingel_Arm_withdrawl.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Surrounded by Imperial forces, the Republic fleet flees the Tingel Arm.]]
{{Quote|Overwhelmed and desperate, the Republic fleet scattered, fleeing from the Tingel Arm to avoid complete annihilation.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
The Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] entered the Tingel Arm on a vector inbound from an exterior arm of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The fleet positioned itself between the worlds of [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] and [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]<ref name="Timeline 6" /> of the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]],<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and [[Ruuria/Legends|Ruuria]]<ref name="Timeline 6" /> in the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> Unbeknownst to the Republic forces, those planets were among those that had already defected to the Empire and were now firmly under the command of the Sith. Caught between the collective forces of the puppet governments set up by the Imperials, the Republic fleet was forced onto the defensive.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

In response to the surprising disadvantage, Republic leaders called upon all available [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] to reinforce the fleet in the Tingel Arm. Despite the additional Republic firepower and personnel, the Sith were still able to [[Space warfare/Legends|overwhelm]] the Republic when the Imperial Navy joined the forces of the Imperial governments of the Tingel Arm. To avoid complete destruction, the Republic fleet plotted escape routes around Sernpidal and fled the region.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> The bulk of the fleet found sanctuary at the planet [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]]<ref name="JoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> in the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|This was perhaps the greatest genius of the Emperor's plot. He had turned the Republic against itself.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
[[File:IrateChagrianSenator-Timeline6.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Senators argue over the organization of the Republic's defense.]]
The scattering of the Republic fleet was one of many signs that the war was not going to be an even contest. After the failure of the foray into the Tingel Arm, Republic military leaders were unable to come to a consensus regarding where the dispersed fleet should regroup, which allowed for further losses in the region.<ref name="JoMGD" /> As a result of the Republic vessels' abandonment of their posts to aid in the Tingel Arm campaign, many strategic regions across the galaxy were left undefended. One such location was the ancient Sith [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], which was left under the protection of only a few [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|Jedi security ships]].<ref name="Timeline 6" /> The Empire, having secured a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] to Korriban by capturing Belkadan, Ruuria, and Sernpidal,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> led a fleet of [[Harrower-class dreadnought|warships]] to the planet and [[Battle of Korriban|retook]] it during the conflict in the Tingel Arm, without the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] even realizing that they had lost it. These events, along with the loss of the Aparo [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and several other worlds in the Outer Rim, caused a panic on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] met in an [[Senate emergency defense session|emergency session]] to organize the defense of the galaxy, but the meeting became mired in [[Politics/Legends|politics]], with [[Senator/Legends|senators]] openly refusing to participate in the proceedings after their worlds were delegated little or no protection from the Republic's armed forces.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

The disorganization of the Republic's government and the growing power of the Empire in the Outer Rim allowed for the Sith [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] to prepare his forces for the long fight toward the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The Republic was on the defensive for the following decade,<ref name="Timeline 6" /> up until a [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|historic stand]] at [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] in [[3671 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline 5">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref> The [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] recorded his experiences during these early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the war in a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|personal journal]], which included records of his concern over the defeat in the Tingel Arm. The [[Book/Legends|volume]] was later the first work entered into the new [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="JoMGD" /> Following the conclusion of the war with the [[Alderaan peace conference]], Gnost-Dural made a new, more scholarly [[Galactic Timeline (in-universe)|holorecord]] on the events surrounding the beginning of the Great Galactic War and again included information on the Tingel Arm campaign.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tingel Arm campaign was first introduced in [[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|''Onslaught of the Sith Empire'']], the sixth installment of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]''. The ''Galactic Timeline'' is a series of web videos presented as historical accounts on the story behind [[LucasArts]]' and [[BioWare]]'s [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The installments are available on the game's [http://swtor.com official site] and are narrated by the Kel Dor [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master Gnost-Dural, who is voiced by actor [[Lance Henriksen]].<ref name="News">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100122_001|text=Onslaught of the Sith Empire|nolive=1}}</ref> The campaign was later mentioned in [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]&mdash;an [[in-universe]] account of the Great Galactic War that was released with the collector's edition of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic|''The Old Republic'']].<ref name="JoMGD" />
